name: Faro
description: Friendly, self-hosted DNS protection and network visibility. This template runs the same Faro application image used by standard Docker Compose.

paths.name: Application Data
paths.description: Faro's database, generated DNS configuration, cached icons, and bounded raw query logs.

ports.name: Web Interface
ports.description: Faro web interface port. Change the host port when using bridge networking; custom-IP installations use Faro's internal port 1787.

ports.name: DNS (UDP)
ports.description: DNS service over UDP. Keep this at port 53 for router-wide DNS.

ports.name: DNS (TCP)
ports.description: DNS service over TCP. Use the same host port as UDP.

variables.name: Query Log Size
variables.description: Maximum size in bytes of each raw CoreDNS query-log file.

variables.name: Query Log Backups
variables.description: Number of rotated raw DNS query-log files retained.
